name: IPC Schema Validation
description: All IPC messages (both ipcMain/ipcRenderer and contextBridge channels) must be validated against JSON schemas. Malformed messages are rejected with structured receipts. Unknown channels are blocked at the boundary.
purpose: Prevent IPC-based attacks by enforcing schema validation on all inter-process messages, ensuring only well-formed, expected messages cross process boundaries.
acceptanceCriteria: Every IPC channel has a registered JSON schema
All incoming IPC messages are validated against their channel schema before dispatch
Malformed messages are rejected with a structured receipt (error code, channel, timestamp)
Unknown IPC channels are rejected at the handler registration boundary
Schema validation runs in the receiving process before any business logic executes
